observations: A safe provider append separates one mutation attempt from bounded readback retries; propagation delay never justifies repeating the mutation.
Caller retry is idempotent only when every requested entry already occupies its exact expected sequence with identical content.
Control-plane integrity, full CI, merge, and byte readback do not establish behavioral capability or completion.
reason: The reusable append boundary is implemented and validated, but the recovered architecture and positive-control directions are still hypotheses requiring separate experiments; no Candidate activation is justified by this unit.
